purpose: single rider-facing call that chains three feature groups and logs the result
image_prompt: Draw a clean left-to-right flowchart for the RideIQ 'Quote' feature. Show input fields entering a box of ML models running in parallel, their outputs combined into a single result, then returned to the Android app as JSON. Flat modern style, rounded boxes, labeled arrows. One /quote request fanning into ETA -> Fare -> Cancellation-risk in sequence, results merged into one JSON and a copy written to SQLite.
